newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late rubber up on Palembang deal.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late rubber up on Palembang deal.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 was higher in late trading on Friday, with a purchase in Palembang helping to lift offer prices, traders said.
They said a Singapore dealer had bought August shipment at 48.00 cents/lb fob Palembang. "I heard SIR20 was done at 48.00 cents in Palembang, but there have been no further details."
Traders said SIR20 offers were 48.50-49.00 cents/lb fob Medan, 48.00 cents fob Palembang and Padang, 48.25 cents fob Surabaya, 47.75 cents fob Jambi and 47.50 fob Pontianak.
"I think prices will edge up a little next week, with some demand coming in," one trader said.
